typeEdit.title: Document type
typeEdit.categoryNote: Personnel: visible to the employee and to those enabled for personnel documents. Company and Customer: to administrators.
typeEdit.multiSendNote: If on, when uploading a document you can choose several employees at once: one document is created for each, with the same file. If off, you choose a single employee.
typeEdit.retentionNote: After this period documents are only flagged, never deleted automatically. Empty = no limit.

folderEdit.title: Folder
folderEdit.visibleNote: Company documents in the folder are also visible, read-only, to employees.

employeeList.title: Employees
employeeList.note: Employees with the key icon (highlighted) have an account and use the app (company users with the User role); the others are registry only and receive documents without being able to view them in the app.
employeeList.notEnabled: Seeing employees requires the personnel documents permission (Permissions page).

employeeEdit.title: Employee
employeeEdit.emailNote: Used for notifications when the employee has no account.

permissions.title: Personnel document permissions
permissions.note: The CompanyPowerAdmin always sees and uploads personnel documents (payslips included); CompanyAdmins only if enabled here. Uploading includes seeing.

settings.title: Document management settings
settings.trashNote: Documents in the trash for longer are deleted overnight. 0 = never.
settings.versionsNote: Keep only the last N versions (0 = all). Documents requiring acknowledgement always keep them.
settings.emailNote: Notify the employee when a new document arrives (if email sending is configured).

features.sottotitolo: Everything you need to archive, deliver and find company and personnel documents.

cartelle.text: A folder tree to organise the archive; folders visible to employees for company-wide notices.

tipologie.title: Types
tipologie.text: Payslip, tax statement, contract...: each type knows whether it has a period, an expiry, a read confirmation and a retention.

personale.title: Personnel documents
personale.text: Reserved: seen by the employee concerned and by those authorised for personnel documents.

invioMultiplo.title: Send to several employees

presaVisione.title: Read confirmation

versioni.title: Versions

ricerca.title: Search

cestino.title: Trash

spazio.text: Storage packages and a warning before it runs out.

pricing.sottotitolo: You pay for the employees and the storage you use: all features always included.

prova.descrizione: To try it with your employees.

pricing.nota: Prices excluding VAT. No commitment: cancel whenever you want.

sicurezza.domanda: Who can see the employees’ payslips?
sicurezza.risposta: Only the employee concerned and the administrators authorised for personnel documents; every access is logged.

cedolini.domanda: Can I deliver the same document to several employees?
cedolini.risposta: Yes: choose it once and select the employees from the list; each receives their own copy.

spazio.domanda: What happens if the storage runs out?
spazio.risposta: Administrators get a warning before it runs out; at the limit new uploads stop until you move to a larger package.

senzaAccount.domanda: What about employees without an account?
senzaAccount.risposta: They stay in the registry and their documents are archived; they see them once they get access to the app.

about.sottotitolo: We have been working for years with payroll consultants, HR offices and companies.
about.paragrafo1: We know how much time is lost emailing payslips, looking for a contract or proving that a notice has been read.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} gathers documents in a single organised archive: those who must see them find them, the others do not.

riservato.title: Confidential

semplice.title: Simple

tracciato.title: Tracked
tracciato.text: Uploads, openings and read confirmations are recorded.
